title: Durable audit ingest + cost-aware partitioning (compact indexing pilot)
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: Audit events for admin/SAML/RBAC actions are growing non-linearly as we onboard enterprise tenants. Our current ingest pipeline writes per-event indexes and materialized blobs that both increase storage costs and worsen compaction pressure during high-throughput bursts. We need an ingest path that preserves write durability and queryability for compliance while dramatically reducing index cardinality and cold-storage cost for older data.

Goal: Implement a pilot that introduces compact indexing, partition hedging, and an ingest backpressure circuit so we can keep 7-day hot indexes with full fidelity and move older ranges to a compacted, append-only layout with queryable rollups. Ensure the pipeline respects RBAC v2 labeling and SAML-related metadata (actor_id, tenant_id, session_id) so auditability doesn't regress.

Success metrics: Reduce per-tenant audit storage cost by at least 45% at 90th percentile ingest, maintain write latency p99 <= 250ms for hot-path, and preserve ability to run compliance queries for >30 day windows against compacted data with acceptable query time (p95 <= 2s for rollup-driven queries).
acceptance_criteria: Hot ingest path keeps full per-event index for last 7 days and meets p99 write latency <= 250ms
Older partitions are compacted into append-only segments with reduced index cardinality and storage cost reduction >= 45% on pilot tenants
Partition hedging policy supports automated split/merge decisions based on tenant QPS and retention class
Backpressure circuit prevents single-tenant spikes from degrading cluster-level SLOs and records throttling events in audit itself
RBAC v2 labels and SAML metadata are preserved end-to-end and visible in both hot and compacted queries
Observability: per-tenant cost/bytes dashboards and an alert when compacted-storage growth exceeds budget thresholds
Migration plan documented and smoke-tested (ingest rollback, read-fallback to coldstore, and reindex job)
implementation_notes: Design a two-tier layout: hot-window (7d) per-event inverted index + compacted archival segments after TTL
Compact indexing approach: keep event-level primary log, build hourly rollups for infrequent fields (session duration, action counts) and a minimal secondary index for compliance filters

Partition hedging: use tenant_id + time window as primary shard key; implement hedging circuit that splits hot partitions when write_rate > threshold (1000 req/s) and merges when sustained low activity
Ingest backpressure: token-bucket per-tenant integrated at ingress (Kafka consumer side) with circuit-breaker metrics emitted to tracing and audit-log collector
Cold spill policy: append-only segments uploaded to cost-optimized S3 class with manifest + bloom filters for cheap existence checks
Query fallback: read-path checks hot index first, falls back to compacted manifests and then to blob scan for edge queries; implement cost-aware query planner to prefer rollups when possible
Data model: ensure RBAC v2 label fields are normalized and stored in the compact index schema; add tenant and actor hashes for faster joins
Operational runbooks: compaction window tuning, emergency rehydrate steps, and troubleshooting guide for stale indexes
notes: 2026-03-01: spike done—benchmarked compacted rollups vs per-event index on 4 TB sample. Rollups reduced index size by ~60% and average query latency for compliance filters improved for low-cardinality fields.
2026-03-04: design review with Security and Privacy. Agreed to retain raw event blob for 90 days before irrevocable aggregation to support forensic needs (legal sign-off required).

2026-03-08: infra prototype uses Kafka topic per-tenant with sticky partitions; observed single-tenant hotspot causing consumer lag—implemented hedging circuit in prototype to split partitions dynamically.
2026-03-10: confirmed integration checklist with RBAC v2 team: ensure label canonicalization and new actor_id namespace won't break existing compliance queries. Need migration shim for legacy labels.
2026-03-11: cost projection for pilot tenants (3 customers) estimates monthly storage savings of $18k vs baseline; ops cost for compaction job < $2k/month.
